task.title: Evidence/result synthesis skill
task.summary_zh: 依 design-closure C1 result-synthesis SPEC 與 SD §7 做 evidence-grounded 結果整合 skill:把多個 ResearchRunSummary + ConsultMemo 整合成可討論卡片資料(VersionPatchProposal/EvidenceSummary),每個結論必須 grounded 在 evidence_refs,不得無根據生成。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: synthesis 輸出符合 C1 SPEC 且每結論有 evidence_refs;無 ungrounded 主張;附測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過
task.next: Closeout complete: evidence scope filter and VPP schema validation implemented per C1 SPEC; 28 tests pass; PR #2096 (implementation) and PR #2102 (closeout brief) both merged to dev

handoffs.message: Implementation complete: agora-result-synthesis skill per C1 design-closure SPEC. Deliverables: integrations/openclaw/skills/agora/result_synthesis/ with skill.py, SPEC.md, test_skill.py (__init__.py). All 21 tests pass (3 golden evals: V3→V4 quantitative comparison, OOS-fail/IS-pass verdict enforcement, consult disagreement preservation). Evidence-grounding enforced: non-insufficient verdict blocked if output evidence_refs empty. Stub/fixture detection with verdict downgrade. Conflict preservation via unresolved_decisions pass-through. No RuntimeBinding/capital-bind/order-route paths introduced. Anchor commit 4de6e0f6 on task/AG-BE-RS-004, PR #2096 open with auto-merge. Please verify against C1 SPEC §Input/Output, golden evals, and hard rules.

Review not approved: proposed_version_patches must validate against v1.3 VersionPatchProposal schema, and output evidence_refs must be validated against the provided/loaded evidence scope so invented refs cannot ground a non-insufficient verdict. See PR #2096 comment https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2096#issuecomment-4762418462

Both reviewer rejections addressed (commit 0fc5877c, PR #2096 updated): (1) output evidence_refs now filtered to input scope — invented refs emit INVENTED_EVIDENCE_REF warning and cannot ground a non-insufficient verdict; (2) each proposed_version_patches entry validated against v1.3 version_patch_proposal.schema.json via jsonschema.Draft7Validator — violations block with PATCH_SCHEMA_INVALID. Stub tests corrected (adapter refs now match input scope). 28 tests pass.

Codex review approved in PR #2096 comment https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2096#issuecomment-4762455360; local verification 28 result-synthesis tests + 11 v1.3 VersionPatchProposal tests passed; PR is still BEHIND and needs branch refresh before merge if required.
